summary.text: Frontend Developer and Information Technology graduate from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HUTECH) with hands-on experience building responsive web and mobile applications using Next.js, React.js, and React Native. Experienced in translating product and design requirements into reusable, maintainable frontend code.

bullets.text: Translate detailed Figma designs into clean, responsive, semantic code and build reusable components with maintainability and DRY principles in mind.
Work with Next.js App Router and Server Components, TypeScript, TanStack Query, TanStack Table, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
Develop responsive interfaces from user and business requirements in an Agile/Scrum team, working with stakeholders in English.
Clarified product requirements, designed the user experience and implemented the frontend across 2 platforms, building the mobile app with React Native and turning own designs into shipped features.
Wrote end-to-end tests with Playwright to ensure product quality.
Used Spec-Driven Development to turn product requirements into a fully functional application with clear specifications and automated validation, across 23 React components.
Designed and built the interface with Claude Design and Claude Code, then verified the generated output with AI-powered testing workflows using Playwright MCP.
Built a Playwright and TypeScript end-to-end UI framework on the Page Object Model, covering 21 automated test cases across 4 browser and device targets in parallel.

requirements.requirement: Under 2 years of frontend experience, or a product shipped to a real environment
requirements.note: About one year of professional frontend work plus a publicly deployed portfolio application.

requirements.requirement: Semantic HTML and modern CSS layout (flex, grid) for complex layouts
requirements.note: Semantic, responsive markup is evidenced; the profile never names flexbox or grid explicitly.

requirements.requirement: ES6+ JavaScript, including asynchrony and variable scope
requirements.note: JavaScript is tiered professional; asynchronous frontend-to-backend data flow in PRJ-ESME.

requirements.requirement: React at a functional level: components, state, effects, why a component re-renders
requirements.note: Production React plus component and state work; nothing in the profile documents re-render analysis or render profiling.

requirements.requirement: Next.js (listed as a plus)
requirements.note: App Router and Server Components in the current role.

requirements.requirement: API integration, asynchronous states and client-side data caching
